decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan and proposed layout plan received 29 May 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access shall not be used until a timber trellis fence has been installed along the north boundary in place of the existing close-boarded fence for a depth of not less than 2.4 metres measured from the front boundary of the property.  The trellis shall have a minimum opening of 12 cm by 12 cm and a maximum thickness of the vertical and horizontal elements Other than the top and bottom rails) of 4 cm.  The trellis shall be permanently retained and not in-filled by any solid material and shall be kept clear of climbing plants

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - The hard surface created shall be made of permeable materials which ensure that run-off water is managed within the curtilage of each application property, and prevented from entering the public drainage system. This shall be maintained at all times thereafter.
